references.text: The Lord commanded Moses to count all male Levites from one month old and upward, which is the same counting criterion used here for Merari's clan.
The Gershonites' count followed the same pattern: all males from one month old and upward, with a total of 7500.
The Kohathites' count using the same criteria yielded 8600 males from one month old and upward.
The summary of all Levites counted from one month old and upward totaled 22,000, which includes Merari's clan mentioned in this verse.
In the second census of the Levites, all males from one month old and upward were counted, and the number was then 23,000.
Here are named Merari's sons Mahli and Mushi, who are the ancestors of the 6,200 counted in Numbers 3:34.
